# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 48 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_048_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 48

**1** Jesus said: "If two people in the same house make peace with each other, they can say to a mountain, 'Get out of the way!' — and it will."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "In the same house" — "this one house" rendered as shared location
- "Get out of the way!" — the mountain-command rendered as direct speech with urgency
- "And it will" — the result compressed; the fulfilment is certain

---
